title: LLM Metacognition — Wiki Page (arXiv:2607.11881)
description: New wiki page covering the first comprehensive survey of LLM metacognitive capabilities (confidence calibration, knowledge boundary recognition, self-correction). Key finding: aggregate calibration ≠ individuated per-query accuracy, undermining confidence-weighted routing. Practical implications for H381/H382 multi-agent trading and dream cycle evaluation.

source.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
source.authors: Gabrielle Kaili-May Liu, Areeb Gani, Jacqueline Lu, Jordan Thomas, Mark Steyvers, Arman Cohan
